  <p class="eyebrow">Behind the project</p>
  <h3 id="adventure-details">A favorite project, revisited</h3>
  <p>This is a redesigned version of a project I made during my freshman year of college. It has always been one of my favorites, so I wanted to give it a fresh look and share it again. There’s no big real-world use case behind it—it’s simply a fun project I enjoyed making.</p>
